description: Defines the interface and data structures for the LearningTaskController class used in media learning tasks, including observation management and prediction callbacks.

classes.name: ObservationCompletion
classes.description: Struct for representing the completion of an observation, including target value and weight.

methods.name: BeginObservation
methods.description: Starts a new observation with a unique ID, features, and optional default target and source ID.

methods.name: CompleteObservation
methods.description: Completes an observation with a given ID and completion data.

methods.name: CancelObservation
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing observation with the specified ID.

methods.name: UpdateDefaultTarget
methods.description: Updates or unsets the default target value for a given observation ID.

methods.name: PredictDistribution
methods.description: Asynchronously predicts the distribution for given features, invoking callback with result.
